notes: Seen on 2026-10-03 in a capture of play (Markiplier's Part 9 of Security Breach, archived at archive.org), 3:22:40 to 3:25:11; the sound was not heard, and the scene was not checked in play by this archive. In order: the game, with two hearts and the icons of a rabbit mask and a green rabbit plush; 'Something is not right...', with a green rabbit plush shown large beside the words (3:23:06); 'This door appears to be locked.', with the Princess before a red curtained doorway that has a keyhole (3:23:40); 'A strange key. I wonder what this opens?', with a purple key shown large, the two icons gone and a key icon in their place (3:23:50); a dark figure with ears in white flashes (3:24:00 to 3:24:16); a panel of green signs ringed in purple (3:24:24 to 3:24:32); black.
